answer: The strongest single control I know for this is RPKI-signed identity announcement, because it ties the right to answer to something scarce. The farm's edge dies on cost: each alias adds 119 POA of exposure, so 579 aliases carry 68901 POA of risk for one epoch's payout. The ocean test is the live device, the opal test is the locked stake, and the vine test is the graded history no template can fake. One mechanism, one cost, one public record — and the farm's maths stops adding up.
